cisco_concept: ICM/UCCE routing script (call type, dialed number)
what_changes: One script per use case, not per number. Number-specific behaviour moves to point-of-contact parameters.
gotcha_or_risk: Scripts are not convertible by a tool. Rebuild from the REQUIREMENT, not from the Cisco flow.

cxone_concept: Point of Contact / skill + script branch
what_changes: Reporting by call type must be rebuilt on skill, point of contact and disposition.
gotcha_or_risk: Historic call-type reports will not match. Agree report definitions with the business BEFORE cutover.

what_changes: Proficiency is lower-number-is-better in CXone (verify in your tenant).
gotcha_or_risk: Do not copy Cisco proficiency numbers across.
Cisco reason code numbers drive reports. Map every one.

cxone_concept: Studio actions (Play, Menu, Capture, REST API)
what_changes: IVR logic is rebuilt. External calls become REST API actions.
gotcha_or_risk: VXML audio files need re-recording or re-encoding. Check codec and prompt format.

cisco_concept: CVP external VXML server / database dip
cxone_concept: Studio REST API action to API Gateway + Lambda
what_changes: Same job, different shape: 10 s default timeout, 32 KB limit, 2 automatic retries.
gotcha_or_risk: Make writes idempotent. Retries will happen.

cxone_concept: CXone Agent (MAX) and Agent Embedded / CRM screen pop
what_changes: Screen pop uses contact data from the script.
gotcha_or_risk: Gadgets do not move. List every gadget and its owner.

cisco_concept: Time of day / Day of week node
cxone_concept: Hours of Operation profile + Hours action
gotcha_or_risk: A missing holiday means the line is OPEN on a public holiday. Test holidays.

cxone_concept: Emergency flag on an Hours profile (the CAT switch)
gotcha_or_risk: Run a CAT drill in the pilot wave.

what_changes: Retention and access rules move to CXone plus the archive bucket.
gotcha_or_risk: Recordings of old calls stay on the old platform. Plan legal-hold access.

what_changes: Real-time boards and historic reports are rebuilt.
gotcha_or_risk: Data warehouse feeds break. Find every consumer of the old reports.

cxone_concept: CXone WFM or the existing WFM tool via integration
what_changes: Forecast history may not be transferable.
gotcha_or_risk: Staffing models must be re-baselined after cutover.

cisco_concept: SBC / CUBE and SIP trunks (carrier side)
cxone_concept: CXone SIP trunks / BYOC through the carrier
what_changes: Numbers are re-pointed by the carrier. This is the real cutover control.
gotcha_or_risk: Carrier lead time can be days. Book change windows early. Rehearse the roll-back call to the carrier.

what_changes: Compliance rules (do-not-call, calling hours) must be rebuilt.
gotcha_or_risk: Do not migrate outbound in the same wave as inbound.

what_changes: Network quality now matters at the agent site.
gotcha_or_risk: Test from the real agent network, including home workers.
